classification.difficultyReason: Identify a neighbouring angle sharing a vertex and arm without overlap.

content.prompt: On the diagram, identify an angle adjacent to:

spec.description: Three arms meet at Q on the right; P is upper-left, S slightly lower-left and R farther lower-left.
spec.mathematics: Retain QP, QS and QR. No measured angles or equality marks.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied answer arc between QP and QS is omitted.

answer.worked: $\angle PQS$ and $\angle RQS$ share vertex $Q$ and arm $QS$, and do not overlap.

spec.description: An answer arc in sector PQS.
spec.mathematics: The marked sector shares QS with RQS and has disjoint interior.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete answer-only native figure; base and added marks share one coordinate frame and bounding box.

spec.description: AB slopes down-right from A to B; AD extends horizontally right. BC and BE extend lower-left from B, with BE steeper.
spec.mathematics: Retain all four segments AB, AD, BC and BE, including the separate arm AD.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied CBE answer arc is omitted.

answer.worked: $\angle CBE$ and $\angle ABC$ share vertex $B$ and arm $BC$, and do not overlap.

spec.description: An answer arc between BC and BE.
spec.mathematics: CBE shares BC with ABC without overlap.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete answer-only native figure; base and added marks share one coordinate frame and bounding box.

spec.description: Four arms from one lower-left vertex: horizontal right, shallow upward-right, steep upward-right and vertical up. Label c lies between the horizontal and shallow arms.
spec.mathematics: No endpoint labels, right-angle square or numerical measures. Internal coordinate names are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only c is visible; the completed arc is solution-only.

answer.short: The angle between the two oblique arms.
answer.worked: The marked angle shares the vertex and shallow oblique arm with $c$, and does not overlap it. The angle between the shallow oblique arm and the vertical arm is also valid.

spec.description: Arc between the shallow and steep oblique arms.
spec.mathematics: One valid adjacent angle; a larger sector extending to the vertical arm is also valid.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete answer-only native figure; base and added marks share one coordinate frame and bounding box.

spec.description: A horizontal segment passes through the vertex. Other arms extend steeply downward-left and shallowly downward-right. Label p is between the left horizontal and downward-left arms.
spec.mathematics: Retain both horizontal arms and both oblique arms; no endpoint labels or measurements.
spec.answerVisibility: The completed arc between the downward arms is omitted.

answer.short: The angle between the two downward oblique arms.
answer.worked: This angle shares the vertex and downward-left arm with $p$, and does not overlap it. The larger angle from the downward-left arm through the lower half-plane to the horizontal-right arm is also valid.

spec.description: Answer arc between the downward-left and downward-right arms.
spec.mathematics: A valid adjacent sector sharing the downward-left arm with p.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete answer-only native figure; base and added marks share one coordinate frame and bounding box.
